## Executive Summary
This project predicts the manner of exercise execution (`classe` variable) using accelerometer data from belt, forearm, arm, and dumbbell sensors. A Random Forest classifier was trained on 70% of the training dataset after cleaning missing values and non-predictive variables.

## Data Loading & Preprocessing
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
set.seed(12345)

train_url <- "[https://d396qusza40orc.cloudfront.net/predmachlearn/pml-training.csv](https://d396qusza40orc.cloudfront.net/predmachlearn/pml-training.csv)"
test_url  <- "[https://d396qusza40orc.cloudfront.net/predmachlearn/pml-testing.csv](https://d396qusza40orc.cloudfront.net/predmachlearn/pml-testing.csv)"

training_raw <- read.csv(train_url, na.strings = c("NA", "#DIV/0!", ""))
testing_raw  <- read.csv(test_url, na.strings = c("NA", "#DIV/0!", ""))

# Remove columns with >70% NAs
max_na <- 0.7 * nrow(training_raw)
keep_cols <- colSums(is.na(training_raw)) < max_na
training_clean <- training_raw[, keep_cols]
testing_clean  <- testing_raw[, keep_cols]

# Remove identification and timestamp columns (1:7)
training_clean <- training_clean[, -(1:7)]
testing_clean  <- testing_clean[, -(1:7)]
training_clean$classe <- as.factor(training_clean$classe)
